title: Honeybound
description: A side-scrolling platformer: Pip, the smallest bee of the Great Hive, walks eight worlds to win the Heartcomb back from Baron Thornwick before the first snow.

folk_lines: HOLD JUMP AS YOU FALL TO FLUTTER, PIP. SMALL WINGS STILL COUNT!
GRUBMAW KEEPS THE FIRST SHARD IN THORNKEEP. HE CAN'T SEE ABOVE HIS OWN HEAD: LAND ON IT!
MADAM DUSKWING STOLE EVERY LANTERN IN THE WOOD. AFTER SHE SWOOPS SHE MUST REST ON THE GROUND.
CAPTAIN BURR ROLLS UP INTO A BALL OF PRICKLES. JUMP HIM, THEN BOP HIM WHILE HE'S DIZZY.
RIMEWEAVER DROPS FROM THE ROOF ON HER THREAD. THE FALL DAZES HER: JUMP ON HER BACK!
IF THE SAND STOPS AND SHIVERS, BACK AWAY. SANDMAW BURSTS OUT, AND HIS HEAD IS YOURS.
GLOAM TOOK THE FIREFLIES' LIGHT. AFTER HE THROWS SPARKS HE GETS SLEEPY AND SINKS DOWN.
QUEEN VESPA DIVES STINGER FIRST. WHEN SHE HUMS AND STOPS, MOVE! IF SHE MISSES SHE GETS STUCK.
THE BARON CHARGES LIKE A RUNAWAY ACORN. LET HIM HIT THE WALL, THEN JUMP ON HIS BACK.
world_lines: THE ROAD BEGINS. THE THORNS ARE ALREADY CREEPING INTO THE MEADOW.
THE DUSKWOOD, WHERE THE LANTERNS HAVE GONE OUT.
AUTUMN HOLLOW. THE LEAVES ARE FALLING FAST NOW.
FROSTVALE. THE FIRST SNOW IS ONLY A FEW DAYS AWAY.
THE SUNSET DUNES: WARM SAND, AND SOMETHING MOVING UNDER IT.
THE STARLIT MEADOW, WHERE THE FIREFLIES HAVE NO LIGHT.
BLOSSOM RIDGE. THE WASPS ARE WATCHING THE ROAD.
THE ASHLANDS. THE BARON'S CITADEL STANDS AT THEIR HEART.
rescue_1: BUZZ: PIP? LITTLE PIP CAME FOR ME?
MARIGOLD: OH! THE LANTERNS ARE LIT AGAIN!
HAZEL: THE CAPTAIN WRAPPED ME IN BRAMBLES FOR SINGING TOO LOUD.
SORREL: BRRR! YOU WALKED ALL THE WAY THROUGH THE SNOW?
THISTLEDOWN: A WHOLE ROYAL GUARD, AND IT TOOK THE SMALLEST OF US TO GET ME OUT.
FENNEL: THEY MADE ME BAKE THORN PIES ALL WEEK. NOBODY LIKED THEM.
BURDOCK: SEVEN SHARDS! THE HIVE WILL SING ABOUT THIS FOR A HUNDRED SUMMERS.
rescue_2: THE BARON'S ARMY MARCHED EAST INTO THE DUSKWOOD. A MOTH THERE HAS THE NEXT SHARD.
MY MAPS SAY THE NEXT SHARD IS IN AUTUMN HOLLOW, WITH A WEEVIL WHO CALLS HIMSELF A CAPTAIN.
NORTH LIES FROSTVALE. THE SNOW HAS ALREADY STARTED THERE.
THE BARON'S CARRIAGE WENT SOUTH, OVER THE SUNSET DUNES. HE IS AFRAID OF YOU NOW.
BEYOND THE DUNES IS THE STARLIT MEADOW. SOMEONE THERE STOLE THE STARS' LIGHT.
QUEEN VESPA HOLDS THE NEXT SHARD ON BLOSSOM RIDGE. SHE HAS AN ARMY OF WASPS.
THE LAST ONE IS WITH THE BARON HIMSELF, IN HIS CITADEL IN THE ASHLANDS.
rescue_3: I'LL FLY HOME THE LOW WAY AND TELL THE QUEEN YOU'RE COMING. ONE SHARD DOWN!
THE LEAVES ARE FALLING, PIP. WINTER IS CLOSE. HURRY!
FIVE SHARDS LEFT. YOU'RE GETTING BRAVER WITH EVERY STEP.
AND PIP... YOUR WINGS LOOK BIGGER. JUST A LITTLE.
HERE: A LITTLE HONEY FOR THE ROAD. YOU'VE EARNED IT.
FINISH THIS, PIP. THE WHOLE HIVE IS WITH YOU.

lines.text: THE GREAT HIVE, ON THE LAST WARM NIGHT OF AUTUMN.
PIP! THE HEARTCOMB IS GONE. BARON THORNWICK BROKE IT INTO EIGHT SHARDS AND GAVE THEM TO HIS LIEUTENANTS.
WITHOUT ITS WARMTH THE HIVE WILL FREEZE WITH THE FIRST SNOW. AND HIS THORNS NOW COVER THE SKY: NOT ONE BEE CAN FLY OUT.
BUT... I CAN'T EVEN FLY YET.
THE THORNS STOP WINGS, LITTLE ONE. NOT FEET. YOU ARE THE ONLY ONE OF US WHO CAN WALK OUT OF HERE.
BRING THE EIGHT SHARDS HOME BEFORE THE SNOW. AND BRING BACK OUR FRIENDS HE TOOK. THE WHOLE HIVE IS COUNTING ON YOU.
BEATEN... BY A BEE WHO CANNOT EVEN FLY.
I DIDN'T NEED TO FLY. I JUST NEEDED TO KEEP WALKING.
THE EIGHTH SHARD SETTLES INTO PLACE. THE HEARTCOMB IS WHOLE, AND ALL OVER THE ASHLANDS THE THORNS BEGIN TO WITHER.
YOU DID IT, PIP. FEEL THAT? THE HIVE IS WARM AGAIN, AND THE SNOW CAN FALL ALL IT LIKES.
AND LOOK AT YOUR WINGS. A JOURNEY LIKE THAT WOULD GROW ANYONE'S WINGS.

scenarios.name: the title starts a new journey: the Queen's call, then the card, then Pip plays 1-1
landing on a grubble flattens it and bounces Pip up
bumping a comb from below brings royal jelly, and eating it grows Pip
a second comb gives grown Pip a firebloom: pollen puffs to throw
a wax block hides a sunpetal: sun power plays its own tune
a stomped snail hides in its shell, and a kick sends the shell rolling
holding down on a hollow stump leads to the honey room, and its side stump comes out further along
after the midpoint a lost life starts Pip there, not at the beginning
holding jump while falling flutters: Pip falls slower than without it
a pit costs a life and the card comes back
losing the last life is a clean game over, then the title offers to continue
the pause menu stands the world still, saves the game and resumes
saving, quitting to the title and continuing comes back to the same stage
a roadside bug says a line when Pip bumps into them
